tests: R1 DOCTYPES lists the eight types in registration order, generic alone the fallback

R3 every type takes its local facts from ctx.view, and with no view from every non-test held profile
R4 each type declares a contract, SUBSTANCE or MEMBERSHIP, generic SUBSTANCE
R5 every event a type's assess emits is the catalogue's, and meaningful is isMeaningful(events)
R6 every connection is referential or temporal, each in its own shape
R7 a type places a reference only where locate says, once per reference with every occurrence, and no source without a locator
R8 the calendar's forward-looking connection reads ctx.now when given, the wall clock only when not
R3 R8 the minutes-due date is the profile's practice counted by civil-time: business days on the profile's own closures
R18 the existing fixtures of every type give the verdicts docprofile gave, apart from the added readings
R20 no place is named in this module's code, and every type is read under a profile that is not the first
R21 deterministic over its inputs apart from R8, and nothing reads a store or the network
R22 an unrecognised document is never assumed decorated, and a type without CERTAIN never asserts unchanged
R23 a reading or a diff that found nothing is a failed reader, and a mass removal is never reported from one
R24 every no says which no and why
R4 R5 R1 a registry filled by registerDoctypes answers as docprofile's did: first CERTAIN, else best, else generic
R1 R25 policy is registered after regulation, matches CERTAIN only on a header naming a series with its number, and is SUBSTANCE
R26 the header block: each field by the view's labels, as written, with its extent; type with its series, number with its normal
R27 R33 sections: outline headings in document order with paths and extents, or none and why
R28 R33 definitions: the entries of a section headed as definitions and the definitional voice, a term given twice twice
R29 applicability: a section headed so and the applying voice, each an extent, never resolved to an office or a person
R30 responsibilities: each row of a responsible-party and action table in order; a table that cannot be told apart is unread
R31 timeframes: each period or limit, amount and units only where stated plainly, and never a deadline
R32 the readings are never force: no provision is labelled required, recommended, allowed or discretionary
R34 assess: a header field or a section that moved, or one read on one side only, each instrument_changed naming it
R35 measured on the 50 captured policies under the held first profile: the header block read wholly right for at least 90%, each field as recorded
R35 R27 section boundaries on the 50, against a member's reading of each one's top-level sections
R35 measured out of sample: 24 fresh policies of the same issuers and series, none among the 50, per header field under the held first profile
R26 the fields below R35's target carry measured below_target, under any profile; the others do not
R26 a revision memorandum's running header naming the order does not anchor the header: the order's own block is read (DGO D-4)
R26 a placeholder date in any blank form ('DD MMM YY') is kept as written with date null and why, never dropped (DGO B-01)
R26 a field's value stops at its line where the order's name follows in capitals, never running into the body (DGO K-6)
R26 the title is read from the header block, never from a contents page's heading (DGO H-10)
R3 R20 policy takes its series and labels from ctx.view, and with no view from every non-test held profile
R36 adding policy changes no other type's verdict: no existing fixture is read as a policy
